crossRefs.note: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

people.name: Beriah
people.line: Levite in the time of David

people.name: Jahath
people.line: Levite, descendant of Shimei, son of Gershon.

people.name: Jeush
people.line: A Levite, son of Shimei or Shubael

translations.web: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.
translations.bsb: Jahath was the first and Zizah was the second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were counted as one family and received a single assignment.
translations.kjv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father's house.
translations.asv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they became a fathers' house in one reckoning.
